decisions.what: jest config uses ts-jest preset and jsdom test environment
decisions.why: Spec explicitly requires ts-jest preset and jsdom for DOM APIs; coverage thresholds set to 90 as specified.
tsconfig.json declares '@/*': ['./src/*']; Jest needs the equivalent mapper so alias imports resolve during tests.

decisions.what: CoordinateTransform validates cellSize via a shared private helper
decisions.why: Spec requires input validation with an error on non-positive cellSize; extracting the check avoids duplication across the two methods.

decisions.what: Grid extends PixiJS v8 Graphics and uses a single stroke() call after batching moveTo/lineTo
decisions.why: PixiJS v8 uses the moveTo/lineTo + stroke({width,color}) API; one stroke per render keeps GPU submissions minimal.

decisions.what: Grid culls off-screen lines by computing world bounds from viewport offset/scale
decisions.why: Spec requires only visible grid cells to be rendered; startCol/endCol/startRow/endRow are derived from the viewport-transformed canvas bounds.

decisions.what: Viewport clamps scale to [0.5, 3.0] and emits change events via a Set of listeners
decisions.why: Spec explicitly specifies the clamp range and asks for a callback pattern for state changes.
Needed so destroy() can remove the exact listener references it registered on the ticker, stage, and window.

decisions.what: main.ts wraps engine.init() in a try/catch and logs success
decisions.why: Spec explicitly requires error handling with console.error and a success log line.

decisions.what: Grid tests use jest.spyOn on instance methods
decisions.why: Spec asks for mocking Graphics methods to verify moveTo/lineTo call counts; instance spies avoid polluting the shared prototype across tests.
